# Senegal

Wealth gradients in fertility and mortality: the values for an OG-Core calibration, followed by the estimates they are based on. Terms are defined in the [glossary](../glossary.md).

## Values for OG-Core

| OG-Core input | Wealth gradient | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `fert_gradient` | −0.76, by age as below | DHS 2023, TFR, plus [age offsets](../methods/fertility-by-age.md) |
| `infmort_gradient` | −0.79 | DHS 2023, infant mortality rate |
| `mort_gradient` | −0.40 | census 2002, 45q15 |
| `imm_pctiles` | not provided | — |

Values are [wealth gradients](../glossary.md#wealth-gradient). Before they are passed to OG-Core, each is divided by 100 × (1 − p), where p is OG-Core's rate at that age ([details](../methods/ogcore-units.md)).

**Fertility gradient by age of mother** (`fert_gradient`; ages below 15 use the 15–19 value, ages 50 and above the 45–49 value):

| 15–19 | 20–24 | 25–29 | 30–34 | 35–39 | 40–44 | 45–49 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| −1.54 | −0.86 | −0.55 | −0.43 | −0.67 | −1.15 | −1.74 |

**Adult and child mortality gradient by age** (`mort_gradient`; ages 15–59: the 45q15 gradient above plus the pooled offset for each band ([age pattern](../methods/general-gradient.md#age-pattern)); ages 5–14 use the 15–29 value; ages 75 and above, and OG-Core's final age, use 0):

| 1–4 | 5–14 | 15–29 | 30–44 | 45–59 | 60–74 | 75+ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| pending | −0.77 | −0.77 | −0.55 | −0.21 | pending | 0 |

Ages 1–4 and 60–74 await a decision on the method (the child-mortality gradient at ages 1–4, and how far the gradient at older ages can be trusted); see [ROADMAP](../../ROADMAP.md) items A3 and B1. Infant mortality (age 0) is `infmort_gradient`, above.

## Estimates

### Household surveys

Latest Demographic and Health Survey (DHS) or Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey (MICS) with a complete wealth-quintile breakdown, for each indicator ([`gradient_library_latest.csv`](../../data/gradient_library_latest.csv); earlier surveys in `gradient_library.csv`).

| Indicator | Survey | Lowest | Second | Middle | Fourth | Highest | Low/high ratio | Gradient |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Total fertility rate (births per woman) | DHS 2023 | 5.4 | 4.8 | 4 | 3.2 | 3.1 | 1.74 | −0.76 |
| Infant mortality rate (per 1,000 live births) | DHS 2023 | 40 | 40 | 32 | 21 | 25 | 1.60 | −0.79 |
| Under-five mortality rate (per 1,000 live births) | DHS 2023 | 54 | 50 | 42 | 26 | 31 | 1.74 | −0.88 |

### Adult mortality from household-death records

Wealth gradients in 45q15 and in age-specific death rates, both sexes ([`adult_mortality_gradients.csv`](../../data/adult_mortality_gradients.csv); [methods](../methods/adult-mortality.md); estimates by sex in the [full table](../tables/adult_mortality.md)). Blank cells: too few deaths to publish.
